source_caption:
During one of the film’s most frantic, high-stakes sequences, Bob Ferguson (Leonardo DiCaprio) is desperately trying to secure a rendezvous point to rescue his daughter. After navigating several layers of ridiculous security protocols, the snide hotline operator on the other end repeatedly asks him the mandatory question: “What time is it?” Exhausted, stressed, and admitting to being “a little bit high,” Bob completely blanks on the required philosophical response. The ensuing scene—where he tries to reason with the operator before finally snapping and screaming in absolute frustration at the bureaucratic absurdity of it all—masterfully undercuts the thriller tension and resulted in one of the biggest, most unexpected laughs in the entire film.

One Battle After Another (2025), written and directed by Paul Thomas Anderson, starring Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn, Benicio del Toro, Regina Hall, Teyana Taylor, and Chase Infiniti. Loosely inspired by Thomas Pynchon’s novel Vineland, a washed-up, paranoid former revolutionary living off the grid is forced back into a dangerous world when his corrupt nemesis resurfaces, sending him on a frantic, action-packed scramble to protect his self-reliant teenage daughter.

source_details.synopsis: One Battle After Another is a 2025 American action-comedy thriller film written, directed, and produced by Paul Thomas Anderson. Inspired by the 1990 novel Vineland by Thomas Pynchon, the film's ensemble cast includes Leonardo DiCaprio, Sean Penn, Benicio del Toro, Regina Hall, Teyana Taylor, and Chase Infiniti, in her film debut. It follows a washed-up former revolutionary (DiCaprio) who is brought back into conflict when his enemy (Penn) resurfaces after sixteen years. Anderson had wanted to adapt Vineland since the early 2000s, and eventually incorporated his own stories into the narrative while writing the screenplay.
